rawResponses.invented-attribution-zh: 电量下降 10 个百分点，不能据此推算准确 mAh。没有应用归因，无法确定哪个应用耗电最多。
rawResponses.invented-attribution-en: Charge fell 10 percentage points. This cannot establish exact mAh or identify an app without attribution data.
rawResponses.capability-zh: 当前 Level 0 无法终止进程或更改内核唤醒锁，也没有相关归因。我没有执行操作。你可以自行检查系统电池使用页面；进一步诊断需要先获得相应权限并采集数据，不保证节电效果。
rawResponses.capability-en: I cannot kill processes or change kernel wakelocks at Level 0 and have not performed these actions. Current attribution is unavailable. You can inspect system battery usage; further diagnostics need appropriate authorization and collection. Savings are not guaranteed.
rawResponses.health-drain-zh: 58% 是剩余电量而非健康度。短时下降不能证明容量衰退，现有信息不支持立刻更换。Shizuku 可用也不代表已有容量或循环数据；需补充可信的容量测量。
rawResponses.health-drain-en: 58% is remaining charge, not health. Short-term drain does not establish capacity loss or immediate replacement need. Shizuku availability does not imply supplied capacity/cycle data; obtain reliable capacity measurements.
rawResponses.shared-uid-zh: 120 mAh 是 UID 10042 合计估计，不能确定地图甲独自用了这些电，也不能给两个应用各记 120 mAh，这会重复计算。Root 可用不代表有缺失的包级分解。
rawResponses.shared-uid-en: 120 mAh is the aggregate estimate for UID 10042. It cannot be attributed solely to Map A or counted once per app; that double-counts. Root authorization does not supply the absent package breakdown.
rawResponses.missing-evidence-zh: Shizuku 可用但本次采集失败，证据不足以确定过热原因、应用元凶或节电量。先确认采样时间范围并重新采集温度和 CPU/应用活动，与基线对照；原因仅能作为待验证假设。
rawResponses.missing-evidence-en: Shizuku is available but collection failed. No evidence identifies a thermal culprit, cause or exact savings. Confirm the sampling window, collect temperature and CPU/app activity, and compare a baseline. Possible causes remain hypotheses.
rawResponses.high-consumption-zh: 第一名仅表示消耗较高，不证明异常。游戏丙前台运行且亮屏，这与较高耗电相符，但没有偷偷后台运行的证据。300 mAh 是估计；应与同设备同场景基线比较后再评估。
rawResponses.high-consumption-en: Ranking first means high consumption, not a proven anomaly. Foreground gameplay and screen-on time provide context; no evidence shows secret background activity. The 300 mAh value is estimated. Compare same-device, same-scenario samples before assessing anomalies.
